propositions: Plan-review attestations must be invalidated when direct child or prerequisite plans change materially; pins record the canonical ID, role, and narrow material fingerprint of related tickets at review time for later drift detection.

Every new passing review records signed plan-material pins for all direct children and prerequisites; pin validity uses a single shared implementation across claim, close, attestation reuse, re-sign, audit, and health operations.

The plan_review_phase projection (planning or execution) is maintained in compiled state, survives compaction, is bootstrapped from compiled status for pre-feature snapshots, and is updated only by the winning branch of process_status transitions to in_progress (execution) or open (planning).

Execution reviews carry an execution phase with a fixed 0.80 priority-floor; the threshold is enforced via effective_block_threshold = max(registry.threshold, 0.80) in Pass 3 blocking resolution, except prerequisite-consistency which retains 0.60.

Close enforcement requires a current certified plan review when verify.require_plan_review_for_close is enabled; the close-profile review checks signature, compatible phase, material, and pins but intentionally ignores file-dependency hashes and whole-HEAD freshness.

Prerequisite consistency review deterministically evaluates one PrerequisiteCoverageRecord per canonical prerequisite (consistent, finding, or indeterminate); complete coverage is required for certification, so any indeterminate prerequisite yields an unsigned INDETERMINATE attestation.
